Mugirl_SlaveOpeningPodCrash.questDescrip.li: questDescription->Two Mugirl escapees have crash-landed near the colony. They are exhausted and need rescue. This begins the opening storyline.

Mugirl_SlaveRefugeePodCrash.questDescrip.li: questDescription->A Mugirl escapee has crash-landed near the colony. She is exhausted and unable to move. You can rescue her; she may choose to join after recovering.

Mugirl_SlaveWandererJoins.questDescripti.li: questDescription->A Mugirl who escaped a slave caravan is asking for shelter. Accept or reject her request within one day.
